mentl/b635c9f:
Inner fn declarations now properly capture parent scope variables via
upvalues, matching the existing lambda compilation pattern.

## Root Cause
compile_fn_decl created a fresh Compiler with enclosing=None, so
resolve_upvalue always returned None and fell back to LoadGlobal.

## Fix
- Wire up enclosing scope: mem::replace to preserve outer scope, set
  as fn_compiler.scope.enclosing for upvalue resolution
- Emit upvalue descriptors (is_local + index) after MakeClosure opcode
- Restore outer scope after inner compilation
- Keep StoreGlobal storage for all fn decls (enables recursive calls)

## Before
fn outer(x) = {
  let data = [10, 20, 30];
  fn inner(i) = { data[i] };  // ERROR: cannot index (data not captured)
  inner(x)
}

## After
fn outer(x) = {
  let data = [10, 20, 30];
  fn inner(i) = { data[i] };  // Works! data captured via upvalue
  inner(x)
}
